messages:
arjun: posted a short video + link to the updated routing policies editor: /staging/policies/editor-v3. Can we do a quick UX + accessibility pass before next week's demo?
zoe: watched it. love the preview trace but two confusing bits: the rule order uses tiny numbers and the visual weight implies bottom-first. users expect top-first.
miles: yeah, flip the visual ordering or add a persistent 'Evaluated first' caret. also the drag handle is only visible on hover which breaks keyboard discoverability.
claire: a11y nit: toggles have no aria-labels when used in compact mode. access-bot: running quick checks now.
access-bot: Accessibility scan: 3 issues. 1) disabled-rule chip contrast 2.9:1, 2) draggable rows missing aria-grabbed/aria-dropeffect, 3) no keyboard reorder affordance.
arjun: for validation messages can we be more actionable? current: 'Rule invalid'. prefer: 'Missing parameter: header X-User-ID. Click "Add placeholder" to insert a sample value.'
zoe: suggestion for preview: allow replaying 5 sample requests and show which rule matched per request with a short reason. small table under simulator with columns: sample, matched rule, reason, fallback.
miles: microcopy tweak: change 'Fallback to compatible variant' -> 'Fallback to lower-capacity model' (product agrees).
claire: mobile: conditions wrap awkwardly. propose showing conditions as stacked pills with ellipses and a 'View full' modal.
arjun: behavior tweak: new rules currently append to bottom. PMs want new rules inserted above the selected rule by default (setting in prefs to control this). Add a tiny hint: 'Higher priority rules evaluated first.'
zoe: add a validation summary banner in the header showing counts (errors/warnings/info) and quick fixes (autofix where safe).
miles: keyboard nav plan: when a rule row is focused, keyboard shortcuts for move up/down, duplicate, and delete should be exposed. show a tooltip with shortcuts.
claire: action items: @miles implement keyboard spec + aria labels, @zoe add validation banner + autofix, @arjun update copy and insertion behavior, I'll prototype the batch-replay UI. access-bot: schedule a re-review next Tue 09:30 PT.
arjun: thanks — i'll post updated frames and a before/after gif when ready. ping me for pairing on keyboard tests.
